preamble: Palatalization of the bilabial nasal [m] to the palatal nasal [ɲ] before front vowels, with loss of the labial closure. It is a defining feature of the Moldavian dialect of Romanian, where all labials (p, b, m) are palatalized before front vowels, giving forms like miel [ɲʲel] 'lamb'. Bantu passive and diminutive forms with m > ɲ are morphologically conditioned alternations and are not counted here.

examples.note: The labials p, b, m become [c, ɟ, ɲ] before front vowels in the Moldavian dialect (copil [koˈkʲil] 'child', bine [ˈɡʲini] 'well').

sources: Wikipedia contributors. Moldavian dialect (Romanian), section Phonetic features. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moldavian_dialect
